title: Sandbox conformance index
description: Machine-readable manifest of the sandbox corpus. Separate from the document and predicate indexes: a case here is a sequence of interactions with a stubbed probe runner, not a value in and a value out.

spec.description: Relative path to the normative document this corpus is the executable form of.

file.description: Case path relative to this directory. Constrained to cases/ with no path separators in the filename, so an entry cannot reach outside the corpus.

section.description: The section of the probe spec this case pins, so a failure points at the sentence it violates.
